# NULL JSFX

> 59 professional audio effects for Cockos Reaper. Minimal design, maximum precision. Free and open source.

## Overview
NULL JSFX is a suite of 71 audio effect plugins written in EEL2 for Cockos Reaper's JSFX platform. Organized into three categories: ONE SLIDER (single-control effects), ESSENTIALS (daily-use tools), and ADVANCED (specialized processing).

## Categories
- ONE SLIDER: 19 plugins with single-control interfaces
- ESSENTIALS: 30 plugins for daily mixing and mastering
- ADVANCED: 22 plugins for specialized creative processing
